name: saar-banking-demo-automation
description: Playwright-based frontend automation for SaaR Banking investor demo

scripts.demo:validate: npx playwright test tests/health-check.spec.js tests/expression-builder.spec.js tests/loan-application.spec.js tests/dynamic-forms.spec.js
scripts.demo:advanced:credit: npx playwright test tests/advanced-e2e-optimized.spec.js --project=demo-full --grep 'Credit Score Expression'
scripts.demo:production:credit: npx playwright test tests/production-ready-e2e.spec.js --project=demo-full --grep 'Credit Score Expression'
scripts.demo:production:forms: npx playwright test tests/production-ready-e2e.spec.js --project=demo-full --grep 'Form Field Management'
scripts.demo:production:full: npx playwright test tests/production-ready-e2e.spec.js --project=demo-full --grep 'Business Value Summary'
scripts.demo:production:clean:credit: npx playwright test tests/production-e2e-clean.spec.js --project=demo-full --grep 'Credit Score Expression'
scripts.demo:production:clean:summary: npx playwright test tests/production-e2e-clean.spec.js --project=demo-full --grep 'Platform Agility Summary'

author: SaaR Banking Team
